def solve_problem():

    lin_expr += 5.94 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.3, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 7.88 * vars['Var_3']

    m.addConstr(5.84 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.61 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.16 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.59 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.29 * vars['Var_6'] >= 215.07, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(5.23 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.92 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.49 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.53 * vars['Var_3'] + 1.71 * vars['Var_4'] + 5.4 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.29 * vars['Var_6'] >= 215.43, name='C7')
